A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that the use of distributed computing systems for CEM applications is feasible and that the performance of these systems for CEM codes is comparable to that of the MPP systems.
this application is a good example of the potential of parallel computing for the CEM community, but that the performance is still not yet satisfactory for the real time needs of the CEM user.

the performance of the CEM code is not dominated by communication costs, and that the performance of a distributed memory system can be improved by increasing the amount of available memory, by using a high speed interconnect, and by using a high quality implementation of the LU solver. 3 refs., 4 figs.
